name: diff-risk-explainer
tagline_zh: 代码改动看得头晕？粘贴 diff，三秒讲清改了什么、为什么改，还附风险提示，像同事帮你 review。
tagline_en: Paste a diff, get a plain-English summary of what changed and why, plus risk flags—like a quick code review buddy.
desc_en: Use to briefly explain small code diffs.
why_zh: 同类工具只列变更，它却结合上下文推理意图，并标出潜在破坏点，省去逐行猜测。
why_en: Others list changes; this one infers intent from context and flags breakage risks, saving you line-by-line guesswork.
